items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: these are some voicings that I stole from Jim McNeely over here that I might use someday

ctx.x: Can you explain your, is there a reason or rhyme to the music on your piano at the moment?

No. There is, sort of. But they don’t all fit together. Each one is in some way some other piece that might someday come into existence. So this is something that just happened one night. It’s not really that good yet, but it could be something. And this and the things here I’m now in the process of trying to come up with a piece for Peter Erskine with the Eastman New Jazz Ensemble that’ll be premiered in May. And so the process of — the struggling process, that’s what this is, and all of this, where there’s no…
Do you ever solve composing problems when you don’t expect that you would? Like taking a walk or being away from the piano?
